name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: I Got Subpoenaed
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=i_got_subpoenaed&n=1)
---
Peter \-- **I just got subpoenaed.** The Trump-style Witch Hunt against us continues by Governor Walz' political appointees at the MN Campaign Finance Board. It has now reached a new level. They are using their administrative subpoena power on a fishing expedition to dig into our operations. And under what pretense? A bogus accusation that we made a corporate contribution against their rules.
## These people are nuts!
Worse yet, they don't even have the balls to serve the subpoena to me. They went snooping around my home during the work day and gave it to my wife right in front of my three little children. **I'm at the office! And they have the address.** If you piss off the Political Class Elites, they'll go to your home and drag your family into it. The **Walz-appointed Board** members are way out of bounds here. But they know that already. That's why their own legal staff recommended dropping the case months ago. We did nothing wrong. But that doesn't matter to them. It's obvious to me what they are doing. Trying to STOP us from exposing politicians who are ruining life in this state. Once you are successful in politics, the Political Class Elites see you as a threat. **You know you are over the target when you are catching flak!** Like Trump said, "They're not after me, they're after you. I'm just standing in the way." Action 4 Liberty's team unapologetically works around the clock to expose corrupt politicians who are working against our freedoms. And we WON'T BACK DOWN EVER! But the Political Class Elites have no ethics. They will do anything they can to STOP you and me.
## They know we're threatening their grasp on power over you.
I'm going to be straight with you. This extreme action by the **Walz-appointed Board** against us is going to disrupt our operations in the month leading up to this very important election. The Political Class Elites want to disrupt us at a critical time. They want us off the game field right now. They want us SILENT. **So I need your help. I need to continue funding our programs that expose these politicians. We're about to launch a massive digital blitz across the state. Can you help me by rushing in a donation today?** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/never_again_donation?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=i_got_subpoenaed&n=2 "Yes, I Will Help You") [Yes, I Will Help You](https://www.action4liberty.com/never_again_donation?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=i_got_subpoenaed&n=2)
---
Imagine in the 4th Quarter of a football game, the refs told the Quarterback he had to leave the field for awhile.
That's what these **Walz-appointed Board** members are trying to do to me before the election.
They want to destroy our operations. They want to disrupt our strategy. And they want me to be scared of them.
**Well, Jefferson once said "When government fears the people, there is liberty. When the people fear the government, there is tyranny."**
This whole fight over the last two years has been a fight against tyranny. And I'd rather die than live in fear of my government.
But that statement isn't easy to make these days. They come for us in so many ways.
We just learned yesterday that YouTube banned another video of ours and suspended our account for one week. All for the grave sin of discussing the 2020 election.
**Peter, I have the courage and strength to stand up against these bullies when I know you have my back.**
That's why I'm pleading with you to help me continue funding Action 4 Liberty's mission right now to expose these corrupt people.
[**Please make a donation**](https://www.action4liberty.com/never_again_donation?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=i_got_subpoenaed&n=3) so we can bring the heat to these politicians in the next 6 weeks.
Action 4 Liberty is the most effective political organization in Minnesota. Our team is able to defeat the radical liberal agenda like no other. Remember, we led the charge that ended Walz' Emergency Powers.
If we are sidelined, politics in Minnesota will be left to the Political Class Elites.
This is critically important!
As I told you last week, we are putting the final touches on our massive digital blitz to expose Walz and the Radical Left.
[**Please help me out by making a $25, $50, $100 or $500 donation right now. Don't let these guys disrupt us in the 4th Quarter. The stakes are too high!**](https://www.action4liberty.com/never_again_donation?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=i_got_subpoenaed&n=4)
Thank you for your support!
**In Liberty,**
****
**Jake Duesenberg**

Roseville, MN 55113

body:
We’ll keep this super quick.
#
Derek,
Earlier this month, a senior analyst at 538 (one of the biggest election-watchers in the country) had one thing to say about Pennsylvania’s U.S. Senate race:
**** **“No one should be writing off Oz.”** ****
---
We know we have what it takes to beat Oz. We have a groundbreaking 67 County strategy, an incredible team of volunteers and organizers, and amazing grassroots donors from across Pennsylvania}. But this is a clear reminder: **We CANNOT afford to slow down this close to Election Day.**
Remember, Joe Biden flipped Pennsylvania blue in 2020 by a *razor-thin* margin. If we’re going to win in November against Dr. Oz — and defend the Democratic majority in the Senate — it’s going to take everything we’ve got.
**[We’ll keep this super quick. We really need everyone to pitch in if we’re going to overcome Dr. Oz’s virtually unlimited campaign spending, flip this seat, and send John Fetterman to the U.S. Senate as Democrats’ 51st vote. Please do your part by kicking in $5 or any amount before our final end-of-quarter deadline next week »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220922-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220922-7354&refcode2=7354_434096_MVDe7r&akid=7354%2E434096%2EMVDe7r)**

Abortion rights. Stopping gun violence. Protecting democracy. Tackling inflation. Everything is on the line in the fight for Senate control, and John is our best chance to save + expand our majority.
_We’ve simply got to win!_
Thanks for everything you do in this fight, Derek.

body: We now have another “Open Letter” – claiming America is “an exceptionally challenging civil-military environment” — signed by 8 former U.S. defense secretaries and 5 former chairmen of the joint chiefs of staff. [Action] OPINION: ANOTHER “OPEN LETTER” WARNING TO AMERICANS [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60357&L=28145&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvb3Bpbmlvbi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1hY3Rpb24rYWxlcnQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=] BY CHRIS FARRELL We now have another “Open Letter” – claiming America is “an exceptionally challenging civil-military environment” — signed by 8 former U.S. defense secretaries and 5 former chairmen of the joint chiefs of staff. The letter is published by “War on the Rocks” a website advertising itself as “National Security. For insiders. By insiders.” The September 6, 2022 commentary is titled, “To Support And Defend: Principles Of Civilian Control And Best Practices Of Civil-Military Relations.” Why a letter like this and why now? name: American Briefing
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ze5u8gk8unnggpf0alrpuf521a530dmm4751veio_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjh6eoj2cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uip76s5mckq3bd1le1pj4sr6ephj4c5gcupn6djhehr7ep3mcjgreolksaq66dpnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjjcopb1cr56upb4phh62p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8iv0)
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zng90ijr9hs8bdurebtrsokdbrrobsi5r5qh2lq0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjh6eoj2cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvpqt0j7snc64qeljijlk6iupdtgeaog1gd4jvj0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjh6eoj2cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgu810lshv3ljgdaacbi28jmdh6q6emkt3j906ko_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjh6eoj2cdh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you, Friend. Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can. And that's why I need your help.

Fellow Conservative:

Winter is coming...
And thanks to Joe Biden, it's going to be a cold, dark season for working families. Inflation just hit 8.3% in August. Food is more expensive than it has been since Jimmy Carter was president!
This would be devastating data any time of year, but now we are heading into the cold fall and winter months, staring at a government-created energy shortage.
Europe's dependence on Russian oil is going to send its economy into a recession when temperatures drop. The United States, which has enough oil and natural gas to be energy independent for 300 years, will feel the pinch, too - because woke, socialist Democrats have shut down
domestic production.
Joe Biden and his Administration would rather see another Great Depression and see poor and elderly Americans go cold in the winter than use the abundant, clean energy God gave us.
We have one chance between now and 2024 to correct course from the Left's anti-energy extremism: the November elections.
Help conservatives top Biden's destructive policies!
Only a conservative majority in Congress will give Americans a fighting chance to stave off Biden's Winter Freeze. And only the House Freedom Fund - and patriots like you - can produce the kind of election night victory we will need.
A small establishment-controlled majority will actually hurt. We need fighting, conservative candidates across the country to win and win big this November.
It's not just about winning votes and taking committee gavels away from the Left. We have to win so big in 2022 that we go on offense and advance policies that expand freedom and opportunity for all Americans.
Can we count on you to donate $25, $50, $100, or more today?
Times are tough, and winter is coming. That's why HFF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contributions to the campaigns you support today. We are 100% committed to victory and 100% committed to you.
Your contributions are an investment in the America we want our kids and grandkids to inherit.
Please give today, as generously as you can, while we still can.

name: American Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0734%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=A0RyBEVCLD6kP70q%2frJHmA&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34886%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cIyPzXmi9FdM1Scc2xivvA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. name: Ron Johnson
subject: I will humbly ask for your endorsement, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

Ron Johnson

story.")**__
My name’s Tiffany Smiley. I’m a mom of three, veteran’s wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I’m running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76758%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bymu%2fh8qLCxtLNRT6OrfiQ&sysid=1 "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I’m running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they’ve been stuck with for _years_.

It’s time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I’m the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I’m getting nervous. We’re _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76759%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pS%2bLFkkdWlYaWkO8v9Pssw&sysid=1 "Can you chip in any amount to help me take

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

Tiffany Smiley

body:

Friend,
As the crisis at our southern border worsens, the Left seems to be up in arms and offended about everything _**except the crisis itself.**_
I haven't heard a peep about the millions of people who are being told by Biden they can just walk freely into our country. I haven't heard a peep about these people being used and abused by the cartels.
There's been no outrage over immigrants drowning in the Rio Grande. No outcries about the 50 immigrants found dead in the back of a truck in Texas.
_**I 've heard no outrage about any of that.**_
The reality is, Friend, illegal immigrants are crossing the border and being left on the streets in border towns. [_**Reject Biden 's open border policy >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5g5rj5bpm04odr0i7okspv1p0r0bku3d28gjm08_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjj62ob3cph2bs)
Biden and the virtue-signaling Left don't care about the safety of migrants illegally entering our country, and they don't care about the safety of Floridians and the communities across America being destroyed by traffickers, smugglers, and dangerous drugs freely flowing into our country.
_**The regime isn 't doing anything to solve the crisis at the border because this isn't a crisis Biden inherited, it's a crisis Biden created.**_
Joe, the woke Left, and their corporate press lapdogs are strategically ignoring that the problem at our border exists.
Failed Border Czar Kamala Harris is dealing with the crisis by simply declaring the border is secure, claiming there is no crisis. Biden is asserting that there are actually fewer migrants coming in through our southern border.
The reality is, the border is more open than ever before under Biden's watch and we've had more illegal crossings take place under his administration than at any other time in our nation's history.
_**This is not a situation where Biden tried his best and it just didn 't work. This was an intentional action Biden took to reverse policies that were effective.**_
The Left has been chirping about political stunts to deflect from the real issues happening at the border, but the biggest political stunt by far has been Biden coming in as president and reversing policies that worked just to virtue signal to his base. [_**Fight back >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zp9frbltuv3lag047u05setingmgcnc3p6efsc7g_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjj62ob3cph2bs)
Joe was willing to risk the security of our nation and the safety of our communities to gain brownie points with his extremist base.
The impact of Biden's border crisis has left our communities ravaged by destruction and despair. The sheer volume of the cartel's dangerous drugs being brought in at such a rapid pace, it's nearly impossible for local communities to tackle.
Biden's refusal to take any action is devastating American communities across the United States with fentanyl now the number one cause of death for Americans between the ages of 18-45.
Americans are being victimized by criminal aliens illegally crossing the border.
These crimes are especially hard to stomach because if Biden would've just done his job, the crime would have never happened.
The fact of the matter is, Friend, the false outrage from the Left has nothing to do with humanity or decency - it has to do with Democrats' seemingly inherent need to posture themselves as morally superior. [_**Hold the Left accountable >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z80pg8ul4vih5mbud0t231qpf9dcj5i534u35818_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjj62ob3cph2bs)
There is a simple answer to our problem: **secure the border.**
We need leaders with integrity who are willing to put the American people above their political standings. Biden and his pocket puppets, like my opponent, wouldn't know the meaning of integrity if it were printed on a rubber wristband or written in 78-point font on a teleprompter.
_**I 'm working hard to keep the Left's extremism out of Florida, but I need your help to stop them.**_
My mission to Keep Florida Free will require the help of every supporter. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines as our country slips further into chaos and destruction.
[_**Can I count on your immediate support? Rush in a donation today >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvige7krcd8ctcr9nhotdsqupq5fe5uoqg37ug30_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjj62ob3cph2bs)

[**RUSH IN A $30 DONATION >>>**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zc08pln1o79clol518lknj60q6l49gj59jnac490_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjj62ob3cph2bs)
[**RUSH IN ANOTHER AMOUNT >>>**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvrc5a16v17pbenhtikhr0j55a2s3mtdkposrv08_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjj62ob3cph2bs)
For freedom,
Ron DeSantis

November 8th isn't too far away. There's a lot at stake in this election, nationally and locally. Preserving democracy, reproductive healthcare access, and protecting our environment are all on the ballot. You know who we can count on to make progress on these issues? Democrats.
Democrats get things done.
HELP TVP SUPPORT DEMOCRATS THROUGHOUT TENNESSEE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]

body:

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51188544/368561001/-1862136002?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjRjZjMwMC00ODNiLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=loB3YHqT25Myz5NUurRACD5-Ka0HYco6ZCgGT5kJB2A=&emci=3a879003-943a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=564cf300-483b-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=15384964)
Peter,

Next week, we're facing the most important deadline of this campaign – our final FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. This is the first deadline we're facing since the primary earlier this month, and with just seven weeks left before the election, we can't afford to come up short. I want to take a moment to explain why.

Now that the primary is over, Republicans are pouring money into this district to flip this seat red. A Kevin McCarthy-aligned super PAC just announced they're spending $1 million to attack me with false attack ads. Why? Because they know Allan Fung will be a reliable vote for their extreme agenda in Congress – from banning abortion nationally to privatizing Social Security.

IMPORTANT DATES TO REMEMBER
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: ELECTION DAY! Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive voted mail-in and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)

Today marks one week until the end of the quarter, and it's a busy time here at Daniels for Congress.

subject: Please, Patriot
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|

| | | Patriot,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me but defeat our values and beliefs.

Every donation makes a difference. Each one can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61371959:6PA5DJVNd:m:1:3299561967:289AD2CFEF1A76DF1A39B1AAE31F5067:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Patriot, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.**********As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61371960:6PA5DJVNd:m:1:3299561967:289AD2CFEF1A76DF1A39B1AAE31F5067:r "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Patriot?")**_********************

body:
Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us.
#
Peter — I’m reaching out myself to ask you to consider making a $5 donation to our campaign before our end-of-month fundraising drive comes to a close. But before I ask, you deserve an explanation of why your support is so important.
Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us. Winning a race as tough as this has to be a team effort. It requires all of us to do the hard work together.
Right now is a moment when we need folks like you to come through for our campaign. We noticed a bit of a fundraising slow down this past week during our budget meeting, and honestly, it was a bit concerning.
My opponent has at least five different outside groups spending on his behalf. Some of the biggest special interests in politics are aggressively trying to buy this seat — including a Koch-backed super PAC, a major corporate special interest group and two of McConnell’s super PACs.
I don’t believe this seat or our next senator’s vote should be for sale. We need a leader who will always put people first. That’s why our campaign is rejecting corporate PAC money.
So that’s why your support is so important. Whether you can pitch in $5 or any amount you can afford, no donation is too small.

Peter, that’s me you’re looking at.

It was 1976. I was in my senior year at Fort Hamilton High School in Brooklyn, and I was scrambling to figure out what direction I wanted my career to go in. I knew that I was lucky to even have the opportunity to decide what I wanted to do next. So many people from my school didn’t have that luxury.
But every time I thought about what career I wanted to pursue, I kept coming back to the civil rights marches and protests that I encountered when I was younger. The Civil Rights Movement consumed the better part of my childhood, and it instilled a fiery passion for justice and equality in me from a young age.

As a child, I loved to read. I remember getting lost in the stacks and picking up a book on Justice Thurgood Marshall. It was then, inspired by his story, that I first began to toy with the idea of law school – at a time when so few lawyers were Black or female, let alone both. I knew that having a law degree would be a valuable tool in the fight for justice and equality, so I decided to pursue law school despite the high barriers to entry.
**Back then, I didn’t know that my fight for justice and my interest in law would take me to elected office – and I definitely never pictured myself becoming attorney general of New York. All I knew was that I wanted to help families like my own,_and that’s exactly what I’ve done. _**
Peter, I’ve spent every moment as attorney general fighting to protect the voiceless and vulnerable – but I need your help to continue my work. **I’m up for re-election this November, and I have to defeat my Republican opponent to continue to fight as your attorney general for another four years, so please: **

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: Mandela Barnes
body:
Derek,
I am writing to ask you to split a $25 contribution between Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood. I hope you will give me a moment to explain why your contribution is so important to his campaign. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes]
Mandela is running to defeat Republican incumbent Ron Johnson, one of the most reactionary and self-serving members of the U.S. Senate. A recent Marquette poll shows Mandela down by one point, and he is up against some very powerful special interests who are spending obscene amounts of money to try to defeat him.
So Mandela needs your help, especially before his FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month.
Ron Johnson is someone who relies on corporate interests to fund his campaign. But Mandela is funding his campaign the right way – from lots of people making small donations.
That is the only way he is going to have the resources to win this race, and that is why I need to ask:
Can you please split a $25 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood? As long as we are in this together, we are going to send Mandela to the Senate and expand the majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes]
[http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes]
At this moment in American history — in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, a global pandemic, and the existential threat of climate change — it has never been more important to elect candidates like Mandela who will fight for the working class of this country.
We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.
Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate.
First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people.
But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face.
Mandela Barnes is in a very close race right now, and he is relying on grassroots support in order to fund his campaign between now and Election Day. So I am asking you one more time:
Please split a $25 contribution between Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood. He is rejecting all corporate PAC money, and your contribution today will ensure he has the financial resources to flip this seat. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220923_CGVA_Barnes]
We are engaged in many struggles right now. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few.
But, in the midst of all these struggles, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country.
That means standing with candidates like Mandela Barnes who will take on powerful special interests. Thank you for adding a contribution to his campaign today.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders
(This is a sponsored send hosted by CommonGood. CommonGood is dedicated to helping Democratic campaigns and organizations win critical races in Virginia and across the country.)

Common Good Virginia

We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0748%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=5gYAgzfhtIAvWnVWjugMyw&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34880%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eADgvBlaiTNkIYspZqFX6A&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34881%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j5nQq3D04Bu51iZdqgjdvw&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34882%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=72CDERGAgxG%2buEPd636e9w&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34883%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fwGTzZ2FSBc13D3zEoKOrA&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34884%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=b2OfEblR%2flQaVltSjqUxkw&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34895%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QTzEN75mjxjZUlzcZAKryQ&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34896%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QbkLwE8abdFzUFj%2bUguH%2fQ&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

| | Friends, Election season is officially here! September 23, 2022 is the first day of early voting in Virginia. As Delegate, I was proud to cast my vote to expand voting access for all Virginians—and the results have meant record voter turnout for our Commonwealth. But here’s the bad news. Republicans in 43 states, including in Virginia, have tried to pass voter restriction laws in their respective states. Sadly, Republicans have been successful in 21 states. In Virginia, Republicans currently control the Governor’s mansion and the State House. We hold a razor thin majority in the Virginia Senate. I am running for State Senate because we need a lifelong, reliable, and proven Democrat in the Virginia Senate to ensure we protect voting rights. The GOP has already made their intentions clear—strip voting rights, strip women’s healthcare access, ban books by Black and LGBTQ+ authors, and give tax cuts to their billionaire donors. Guess what? Not if we have anything to say about it. Today, I want you to go and vote in our midterm elections, and take all your friends and family with you. The great John Lewis once said, “Democracy is not a state, it’s an act, and each generation must do its part.” Let’s get out there and vote and do our part to protect our democracy and our human rights. I’m right there with you. Vote early in:

Becca's approach to her work and commitment to constituent services has always impressed me. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51201852/368611117/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZWRhYmRhNS01YTNiLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ai1EuOjxMCMndUGlXrzZzvPkqioRRdYbeJjIT7T4xGE=&emci=9b778fcd-4d3b-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=bedabda5-5a3b-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402272) | Dear Peter, My name is Elizabeth and I'm Becca's wife! We met 22 years ago and we've been married for 17 (it'll be 18 in October!). We've been through a lot in those years, but what has always impressed me about Becca's approach to her work is her commitment to constituent services.

_Senators in Vermont do not have any staff._ There's no one else to field phone calls — except when we still had a landline, it was me. I'd make a long list of all the folks who were calling because of issues with various governmental departments. **Becca called every single one of them back.** And then, she'd make a plan with them to solve their problem.

**You see, Becca and I both believe that there is no duty more solemn than that of representing other people in our government. We know that trust is built in small steps, and it is only when public servants like Becca partner with their constituents that our government works for all of us. Earning back the public’s trust in government starts with electing leaders like Becca — leaders who understand that doing the work takes time, sacrifice, compromise, and a willingness to make mistakes, own them, and make them right.[We desperately need more leaders like Becca. clean_body: Becca's approach to her work and commitment to constituent services has always impressed me. | | Dear Peter, My name is Elizabeth and I'm Becca's wife! We met 22 years ago and we've been married for 17 (it'll be 18 in October!). We've been through a lot in those years, but what has always impressed me about Becca's approach to her work is her commitment to constituent services. Senators in Vermont do not have any staff. There's no one else to field phone calls — except when we still had a landline, it was me. I'd make a long list of all the folks who were calling because of issues with various governmental departments. Becca called every single one of them back. And then, she'd make a plan with them to solve their problem. You see, Becca and I both believe that there is no duty more solemn than that of representing other people in our government. We know that trust is built in small steps, and it is only when public servants like Becca partner with their constituents that our government works for all of us. Earning back the public’s trust in government starts with electing leaders like Becca — leaders who understand that doing the work takes time, sacrifice, compromise, and a willingness to make mistakes, own them, and make them right.= If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Vermont senators are only paid during the session, from January to June. I used to joke that she should put an "out of office" message on her email from June through December — but she never did. I want her to represent me, because we desperately need leaders who can inspire all of us to remember that our government works for US. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washin

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4tv17t55e0j29j5jsc1s2f43mhtak349p4qkg70_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv3mblhf5d3mguotjqa4p36bpdvmuciuhka6fibg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3d4kf432ecsp075bo93dsg4krp1fs4rco8n8rag_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn5gfklsl058vpe1t5r9cjmrs8imf084acpt9jdo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z30td3knlr966eah68blfb11ieh48sqgjdi2u908_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdjpq5vtfsf04jdj6h7ga6t393vvvb48pt5qfc48_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zncb9tgjesuprkt41b3bnvvt7f42udp527hlc85g_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqqk2u7u5ll29f42vkdcra4rsacvclntttcrsl98_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfrpg53b4s5rokk9lj3urioqpq78m4mp9s7vr6m0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmdbjk8n0nfvbg9mgndctn2ohiom4det90e5hqn0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z02n4m6lv9ejtagcgjvrn08vf04f23kcntlq82pg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn66ulecllr7rksi5f9g76qukf5lhc1ffgkj6cso_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zndg6ekf9c4evr5m00pg3rmtfneclphe3ht59p00_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0o67j6cernq3gjdldd08ubouh8vpbv4osh6cgn0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z84pgbamoccapffc7pefsape6i3m9ap1d8pmdsfo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8mk09174vger8mmkv88b2epehghnt80t9gfe6vg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgmhi7bv2bk9p6grpsdkrqpqfr769pvfagt5a2to_rp22sh2s8i66or6cjgm1o76c3h2bs "Step up now!")**_

Earlier this week, we reached out to ask for your support for the _Reproductive Freedom for All Act_. Protecting women’s autonomy continues to be a top priority for many of you, and as some in Washington ramp up attacks on reproductive rights, I am keeping up my efforts to get our bill passed in the Senate. body:
|
| | | Peter,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

Dear Peter,
We’ve seen it happen time and time again.
From spreading misinformation about voting to purging voter rolls, the Pennsylvania GOP is committed to disenfranchising Pennsylvania voters.
Mehmet Oz said he’d support voter ID laws that we know largely exist to disenfranchise communities of color. This summer, he tried to get legal mail-in ballots thrown out [https://www.thenation.com/article/politics/dr-oz-voting-rights/] , effectively ignoring the landmark Civil Rights Act.
As for Doug Mastriano, he’s the biggest voting rights villain of them all. He consistently peddles The Big Lie, the baseless conspiracy theory that the 2020 Election was “stolen.” He’s said he’ll make all Pennsylvania voters re-register to vote [https://whyy.org/articles/doug-mastriano-voters-re-register/] , a policy that scholars have said may violate not just state and federal laws but also basic constitutional protections.
Who is he kidding?
That’s not even the worst of it. If he wins in November, Doug Mastriano will appoint a Secretary of State to control our elections — and he says he’ll appoint Q-Anon supporter Tony Schuppe. Bottom line? The 2024 Presidential Election could rest solely in Doug’s power-hungry hands.

| | | **These Latino leaders helped take action in their communities.**

Friend,
As we continue to celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month, let’s take a few minutes to recognize, learn, and honor the pioneers of progress for Latino communities.
Dolores Huerta, Sylvia Rivera, and Willie Velásquez were activists who fought for Latino civil rights. Each of these individuals helped pave the way for Latinos by raising political awareness, protecting BIPOC in the LGBTQ+ community, and organizing to fight for better working conditions for farmworkers.
**Our history has shown the power we have when we come together and fight for those in our communities, so let’s continue on the path these leaders have paved for us and keep mobilizing.**
[Interested in getting involved? Volunteer with us and help advocate for the Latino community!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51205136/368622040/-1325114181?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDIwZGEyNi02MTNiLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I5CeYYjdJnAnC4e0tD1Qfgh2OrSksx8eMvZy-kCmbkk=&emci=d8ed2c54-ba39-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=b020da26-613b-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)
**Let’s start with Dolores Huerta** — co-founder of the United Farm Workers Union and Latina icon. She brought women into the labor movement and challenged sexism and racism. She negotiated the first successful collective bargaining agreement by agricultural laborers in 1966. She is one of the most influential labor activists of the 20th century and a leader of the Chicano civil rights movement.
**Sylvia Rivera** — one of the most prominent transgender icons in the Latino community who helped advocate for transgender rights at Stonewall back in 1969. In 1970, Rivera, along with her close friend and LGBTQ+ activist, Marsha P. Johnson, founded Street Transvestite Action Revolutionaries (STAR) – an organization committed to helping homeless transgender women. In addition to offering food, shelter, and safety, STAR fought for the passage of the New York City Transgender Rights Bill and a transgender-inclusive New York State Sexual Orientation Non-Discrimination Act.
**Willie Velásquez** — co-founder of the Mexican-American Youth Organization and voting rights advocate. Velásquez’s greatest legacy was founding the Southwest Voter Registration Education Project in 1974 which encouraged Latinos to run for office, litigated 85 successful civil rights lawsuits, and organized hundreds of nonpartisan get-out-the-vote efforts.
These leaders showed resilience and strength in the face of oppression and injustice. Their sacrifices, losses, and labor have earned them a legacy that will be cherished for generations. They inspired thousands and brought hope to the Latino community in troubling, uncertain times.
**We will remember these pioneers as the ones who started the race, but it’s up to us to grab the baton because now, it’s our turn to be pioneers and keep fighting for justice amongst our Latino communities.**

Dolores Huerta, Sylvia Rivera, and Willie Velásquez were activists who fought for Latino civil rights. Each of these individuals helped pave the way for Latinos by raising political awareness, protecting BIPOC in the LGBTQ+ community, and organizing to fight for better working conditions for farmworkers. Our history has shown the power we have when we come together and fight for those in our communities, so let’s continue on the path these leaders have paved for us and keep mobilizing. Let’s start with Dolores Huerta — co-founder of the United Farm Workers Union and Latina icon. She brought women into the labor movement and challenged sexism and racism. She negotiated the first successful collective bargaining agreement by agricultural laborers in 1966. She is one of the most influential labor activists of the 20th century and a leader of the Chicano civil rights movement. Sylvia Rivera — one of the most prominent transgender icons in the Latino community who helped advocate for transgender rights at Stonewall back in 1969. In 1970, Rivera, along with her close friend and LGBTQ+ activist, Marsha P. Johnson, founded Street Transvestite Action Revolutionaries (STAR) – an organization committed to helping homeless transgender women. In addition to offering food, shelter, and safety, STAR fought for the passage of the New York City Transgender Rights Bill and a transgender-inclusive New York State Sexual Orientation Non-Discrimination Act. Willie Velásquez — co-founder of the Mexican-American Youth Organization and voting rights advocate. Velásquez’s greatest legacy was founding the Southwest Voter Registration Education Project in 1974 which encouraged Latinos to run for office, litigated 85 successful civil rights lawsuits, and organized hundreds of nonpartisan get-out-the-vote efforts. These leaders showed resilience and strength in the face of oppression and injustice. Their sacrifices, losses, and labor have earned them a legacy that will be cherished for generations. They inspired thousands and brought hope to the Latino community in troubling, uncertain times. We will remember these pioneers as the ones who started the race, but it’s up to us to grab the baton because now, it’s our turn to be pioneers and keep fighting for justice amongst our Latino communities. Thank you, NextGen America | NextGen America 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

name: Madison Gesiotto Gilbert
subject: I gave birth on Monday
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Madison for Congress
body:
| | |
---
| | Peter,
---
On Monday September 19th, 2022 my husband and I welcomed our son -- Marcus Christopher Gilbert Jr. -- into the world.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r)
---
| | Just look at how happy we were, Peter... That is until Nancy Pelosi came into the picture.
**_As we were enjoying our first moments as a family, my campaign team reached out to tell me that Nancy Pelosi launched a six-figure ad campaign against me for being pro-life. _** On what should've been one of the best days of my life, I was **CRUSHED** that Nancy Pelosi and her cronies would launch such a despicable attack. Pelosi and her pro-abortion radicals were waging war against me by filling the air waves with ads labeling me "extreme" and "dangerous" all because I dare to stand up for the most innocent and vulnerable among us. _Can you even believe it?!_
---
[**HELP ME FEND OFF THEIR ATTACKS**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r)
---
| | Nancy Pelosi showed that there is no level she won't stoop to to hang on to her power as Speaker.

Look, I know how nasty career politicians can get when they are in danger of having the rug pulled out from under them and losing their power. But this level of vitriol and complete disregard for my newborn son and I is unlike anything I have ever experienced before. **[Will you defend me?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r)** Let's get one thing straight: Nancy Pelosi doesn't give a damn about you and your family anymore than she does mine.

**Nancy Pelosi's priorities start and stop with Nancy Pelosi.**

But I am running for Congress as the antidote to the disease that is self-serving career politicians. I'm an outsider who's never run for public office before -- Pelosi is **TERRIFIED** that the American people will **FINALLY** hold her accountable.

I have always been passionate about helping my community. I have always been unapologetically pro-life. And I have always been an America First free-thinker.

Now that I have experienced the blessing that is motherhood, the passion and fire within me has only intensified.

_**[So to Nancy Pelosi, I say this: BRING IT ON!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r) **_

**Throw all of the disgusting attacks at me that you want -- this Mama Bear is not going to back down. I have too much to fight for. ** But this fight is not just Madison vs. Nancy. This is about the American Dream vs. an American NIGHTMARE. In Pelosi's American Nightmare... criminals get off scot free, borders are wide open and education is replaced with indoctrination.

But the American Dream that I am fighting to protect is centered around law and order. A nation where leftist activists don't dictate what students learn, and parents are put in control of their child's education. Where putting America FIRST is not just a catchphrase, rather a way of life.

**[I can win this fight, but I can 't do it alone. Nancy Pelosi is attacking my family now, but it will be your family next. Help me put a stop to Nancy Pelosi and her radical henchmen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r)**
Thank you for joining me,

Madison Gesiotto Gilbert

** _P.S. Any help you can provide will go a long way toward me winning this TOSS-UP district. My opponent is getting bailed out by her big-wig allies in Washington. I 'm still working to get back on the campaign trail, but I'm at a SEVERE disadvantage until I fully recover. I had our finance team create this secure link for you to rush in support before it's too late: [_MadisonForCongress.com/FightBack_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r)_**
---

---
[**CONTRIBUTE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61377135:Je1VPJVN_:m:1:3317145305:8E296D1BD001E71684F7D773B7BD4ABF:r)

subject: They gave us no warning
body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6091%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=QqdfHrlseNpxKF6earKmPg&sysid=1)
| | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86657%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6CHNpfSXDVywNTk%2f6rRhbA&sysid=1)
---
|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming -- which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86658%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pKjWUfcqbpF0FtvR3qYT9A&sysid=1)
---
[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86659%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PPgepW6AnKC20d7I%2bPqBAg&sysid=1)
---
For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” -- so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86650%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b2AuDPCDW3mzDRTTWY0Csg&sysid=1) And remember -- you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86651%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fR1NW%2bWF5RnY%2bFuXlfbD4Q&sysid=1) Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine. [**Join the rebellion today.**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86652%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iF0hR45%2ffevCPCDOyhEeMA&sysid=1)
---
Sincerely, Seth Dillon CEO The Babylon Bee

body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6459%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=b3tJPBwTkVSCC2wUfErCzQ&sysid=1)

---
|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. body:

| | |
Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61376553:J88IMJVIN:m:1:3253819041:26C89FB32D59D1F0CC0834D846958DFE:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61376553:J88IMJVIN:m:1:3253819041:26C89FB32D59D1F0CC0834D846958DFE:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $10 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61376553:J88IMJVIN:m:1:3253819041:26C89FB32D59D1F0CC0834D846958DFE:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

I've got 15 minutes in between meetings, friend, so I thought I'd send a quick note to you about the state of our race.
All eyes are on Georgia, and experts are saying that I'm one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection. While it's worrying, my focus has been, and always will be, getting things done for Georgians and bettering our nation.
But while I'm working in the Senate to lower costs for hardworking families, defend voting rights, and more, my opponent, Herschel Walker, is busying himself with fancy fundraisers and rallies alongside Donald Trump.
Now, everyone from _Politico_ to _FiveThirtyEight_ reports that _this_ race could decide Senate control, and the GOP is coming after me as its top target for defeat. They'll do and spend whatever it takes to flip my seat; GOP super PACs have already launched round after round of attack ads against me.

**I'm in this fight to serve the people – not politicians like Trump. No big checks from corporate PACs. No extremist rhetoric or conspiracies. But with polls showing me 2 points down against my opponent, I'm counting on your immediate grassroots support to fight back and win.**

**[Will you please chip in $5 or more today to help me keep Georgia blue and defend our Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51187831/368557121/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4090-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmNjMjE5OS00NjNiLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A1Vi8sH8ZKbZIZrUw-bL0zMFbfnYHgrXdCztONSMlBk=)**
Thank you for everything you do. Your support truly means everything to me, and importantly, is how we'll win.

– Rev. Raphael Warnock
