subject: All she does is win...
body:
| |
---
Friend, Ever since Brenda Siegel started her campaign for Governor, we’ve witnessed an incredible phenomenon: **** Brenda is so effective that just by running for Governor she’s already been able to make meaningful change for Vermonters. **** The Phil Scott administration is so disorganized that just in the last few months, they have attempted to strip people of critical rental assistance just as winter begins, botched getting childcare funds allocated by the legislature to providers and now he's threatening to change the collectively bargained health insurance of our state employees and teachers. **** And when Brenda calls out him on something, miracle of miracles, it gets fixed! **** Last winter, when Phil Scott was threatening to throw people out of motel shelters and into the cold of a brutal Vermont winter, Brenda slept rough on the steps of the Statehouse until the Scott administration reversed course and kept those people housed. And just this past week, after screwing up the paperwork for the rental assistance program, the Scott administration "found" a bunch of money to try and push off the rental assistance problem until well after the election. **** It’s been incredible to watch. Brenda just keeps winning on the issues that matter most. She’s called so much attention to important issues like the housing, climate and the overdose crisis that the Governor has been forced to respond. **** Imagine how much better she would be if we just cut out the middleman and made Brenda herself our Governor. We could just get it right the first time, instead of having an administration that we have to pressure to do the right thing after they make a mistake. **** This November, we have the opportunity to elect one of the most effective advocates I have met. Brenda has been delivering for Vermont for years without even holding elected office. If we make Brenda our Governor, the sky’s the limit for our state. Brenda has a huge fundraising deadline in a few days, and she needs our help meeting her goals. clean_body: | | Friend, Ever since Brenda Siegel started her campaign for Governor, we’ve witnessed an incredible phenomenon: ** Brenda is so effective that just by running for Governor she’s already been able to make meaningful change for Vermonters. The Phil Scott administration is so disorganized that just in the last few months, they have attempted to strip people of critical rental assistance just as winter begins, botched getting childcare funds allocated by the legislature to providers and now he's threatening to change the collectively bargained health insurance of our state employees and teachers. And when Brenda calls out him on something, miracle of miracles, it gets fixed! Last winter, when Phil Scott was threatening to throw people out of motel shelters and into the cold of a brutal Vermont winter, Brenda slept rough on the steps of the Statehouse until the Scott administration reversed course and kept those people housed. And just this past week, after screwing up the paperwork for the rental assistance program, the Scott administration "found" a bunch of money to try and push off the rental assistance problem until well after the election. It’s been incredible to watch. Brenda just keeps winning on the issues that matter most. She’s called so much attention to important issues like the housing, climate and the overdose crisis that the Governor has been forced to respond. Imagine how much better she would be if we just cut out the middleman and made Brenda herself our Governor. We could just get it right the first time, instead of having an administration that we have to pressure to do the right thing after they make a mistake. ** This November, we have the opportunity to elect one of the most effective advocates I have met. Brenda has been delivering for Vermont for years without even holding elected office. If we make Brenda our Governor, the sky’s the limit for our state. Brenda has a huge fundraising deadline in a few days, and she needs our help meeting her goals. ---
| **Jeremy Shaffer Releases Second TV Ad, "American Jobs"**
---
| **Gibsonia, PA** – Today, Western Pennsylvania entrepreneur and engineer Jeremy Shaffer released the second tv ad of his general election campaign to counter misleading, negative ads being run by two Super PACs associated with Democrat House Speaker Nancy Pelosi. The ad began airing on broadcast and cable across PA-17 this morning.

"We're proud our campaign is in a position to offer voters the truth about Jeremy's record as a successful entrepreneur who's employed dozens of Western Pennsylvanians while building a company that's improved our roads and bridges," said **Trevor Naglieri, Campaign Manager for Jeremy Shaffer**. "While liberal lawyer Chris Deluzio recently sold his Manhattan condo and moved into the district just two months ago to run for Congress, Jeremy has been creating jobs here in Western Pennsylvania for decades."

Watch the ad by clicking the following link or read the transcript below: [https://youtu.be/jZzqy0rYwYc](https://JeremyShaffer.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=168b3aab49521aba8263d07fe&id=1b79c09e0c&e=32107e7cf1)
---
|
---
_I'm Jeremy Shaffer.

My college roommate and I started a business in our Pittsburgh apartment to keep our roads and bridges safe.

After five years we got our first customer, and created good, high-paying jobs all in Pennsylvania.

I'm proud of the company we built and the American jobs we created.

When other companies left Western PA, we stayed. Every job is still here.

I’m Jeremy Shaffer. I approve this message because I’ve actually created jobs here in Pennsylvania and I will always protect yours._
| ###

Peter!

If you ever considered donating to my campaign,_**it should be right now. Read on:**_

I know you've already heard from my team and me a TON this month, but that's because **September is THE most important fundraising month of this campaign cycle.**

And I'm getting anxious - we're already behind the LAST FEC Quarter Deadline.

You're hearing this straight from the mouth of Dr. Mehmet Oz: **we are about to miss THE SINGLE MOST CRUCIAL FUNDRAISING DEADLINE TO DATE.**

If I miss this last Quarterly goal, it's going to be extremely difficult to win this election. It's THAT important.

Friend: It's David Hogg – gun safety advocate and Parkland survivor. I want you to remember these numbers:
**$3.3 million.** That's how much Marco Rubio has taken from the gun lobby to stay in Congress, even after 14 students and three staff members were massacred at my high school in Parkland, Florida – the deadliest high school shooting in American history.
**$1.05. **That's how much money per Florida high school student that Marco Rubio has taken from the gun lobby. That's the price of student lives for Rubio, as he continues to block any progress on gun safety reform.
**$100,000.** That's how much I'm helping Val Demings raise by midnight tonight so she has the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and become Florida's next U.S. senator.
**It's an ambitious goal – but that's what it takes to beat a candidate backed by the gun lobby and elect a champion for gun safety.[Please, will you join me in supporting Val Demings by chipping in $5 or whatever you can spare to hit this goal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51222544/368650635/1942114991?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4398-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MmU3NTZlYi03MTNiLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kS0PJXxW5zUoAff9fM1EeTH2XTwUcPKBndXFZ4GftuY=)**
While Marco Rubio has spent his career cozying up to the gun lobby, Val Demings has seen the horrors of gun violence up close. | | Friend,**

** Laura Kelly released a new video ad on Wednesday stating that “of course” men should not play in women’s sports. Yet, she has **vetoed the Fairness in Women’s Sports TWICE both in 2021 and 2022.

**
---
[](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=bbbc2e40f5904527b11c07d07a88629a&_e=anNhpMjh4M1tVO21ZI7yrbffFAK1AENYQ1J9B-TdQaf_6vw-YtgFJmi-o8SPVpAABspYyojt7vWedyQ9uH-4GaIs3kurbfHBph-Xs7w_Ua3o87dDF-_RjukYteIPEYRHJP48qG30vLuDTBC7P5Ww6O321bd6HxD1irtKqHLF8gRHZIs2tv0r-7S2GAyfZpX6lRvDagTW7cME6DnAso-HrgLp5MmSbwvCWECPhlYmxg6rDRwRs44kW33bIE9beCDu-30ubaLd6brXNQqgKMhqtonAvYSrsAun7tRMDMPFvHALRSuWUttmYrL6GubwQR1au6oTOipDtkQ7TaR4kkWrvvwdSjOEA2969WQxKADf0Nx-S8JbuM_3RBJQA8iy84mPNQQnCdL-bH_rzf397bjVV0iilF4ipRTdPGgtSUlxLstnfUK-Jh4ag921THloVYrIxz7uSyw7rJWqCyCyTSe2aw%3D%3D)

Then, she flip flopped - doubling down on her support for biological males competing in women’s sports. She told the _Kansas City Star_ editorial board she backs the NCAA policy that forced Riley Gaines and other women to compete against Lia Thomas - a transgender swimmer who had competed on the men’s team for the prior three seasons.

---
[](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=bbbc2e40f5904527b11c07d07a88629a&_e=anNhpMjh4M1tVO21ZI7yrbffFAK1AENYQ1J9B-TdQaf_6vw-YtgFJmi-o8SPVpAABspYyojt7vWedyQ9uH-4GaIs3kurbfHBph-Xs7w_Ua3o87dDF-_RjukYteIPEYRHJP48qG30vLuDTBC7P5Ww6O321bd6HxD1irtKqHLF8gRHZIs2tv0r-7S2GAyfZpX6lRvDagTW7cME6DnAso-HrgLp5MmSbwvCWECPhlYmxg6rDRwRs44kW33bIE9beCDu-30ubaLd6brXNQqgKMhqtonAvYSrsAun7tRMDMPFvHALRSuWUttmYrL6GubwQR1agcOYVk1XJLWgbnJVJ40cVDGJjKvTINJEu-wyUyY3J4pePDKm4d44TurSBEdU3vlKIxKH78QQqmyRAgAovBWoZBSpoZjnJYABn-5K--9qRl1D0azfL3ORWC_-6vbVPnGTl4rkl6kAGz8wIdAMh0irVA%3D%3D)
---

Our governor keeps telling us she’s in the middle of the road, but the truth is, on this issue and on many others, she is far from the middle. Kansas is not California and it is not New York and we don’t want to be.

---

clean_body: | | | | We have to fight back. | Friend, Did you see what Harriet received? A group of Wyoming lawyers has sent a threatening letter to Harriet, because she holds a different opinion of the 2020 election than they do. The lawyers barely disguised their threat to file a bar complaint against Harriet if she does not stop exercising her 1st Amendment right to free speech. They even “instructed” her that she is not allowed to criticize Joe Biden! Take a look at their letter . Here in Wyoming we don’t back down from bullies, that is why Harriet issued the follow statement: “Make no mistake, this letter is meant as a threat against me simply because I hold a different political opinion – one that is shared by a majority of Wyoming voters. And this is exactly what Liz Cheney’s allies and the left do to Trump supporters and conservatives at every turn – attempt to threaten, intimidate, and cancel anyone who doesn’t see the world the way they do. The letter appears to be part of a larger national collusive effort by leftists and political insiders to target Republican lawyers who have concerns about the 2020 election, with the65project.com possibly providing the template for the letter sent to me.” “There remain serious questions about that election, including hundreds of millions of dollars spent by Mark Zuckerberg to commandeer local elections offices in Democrat precincts, and the fact that a Pennsylvania court ruled that their state’s mail-in voting law is unconstitutional. As a constitutional attorney, I have spent my career fighting for the rights of others, and now a group of my fellow lawyers is trying to squelch my own 1st Amendment rights because they disagree with me. And let’s be clear – this is not just an attack on me, it’s also aimed at conservative Wyomingites and anyone who supports President Trump. I’d like to say I’m surprised by this behavior, but it’s just what elites – and those who consider themselves elites – do.” But words aren’t enough. We need to make our position loud and clear that we STAND WITH HARRIET! | | | | | | | We defeated Liz Cheney by not backing down from a fight and we can defeat these bullies by doing the same. Thank you, Team Hageman | | | | |

Friend -

It's retired Naval Special Warfare Officer Ryan Zinke.

I want to tell you a story about service, sacrifice, and the opportunity we have to save the country that I swore to lay down my life for.

At Basic Underwater Demolition/SEAL ( BUD/S), where I trained and where the most HIGHLY skilled sailors train to become Navy SEALs - there's a bell. This ship's brass bell looms over the grounds and is any tired sailor's ticket out of the grueling course.

Tired of running and swimming? _Ring the bell._
Not enough sleep?_Ring the bell. _
Too hungry to keep going? _Ring the bell. _

Ring the bell three times? _It 's all over._

** Your chances at joining this elite fighting force is GONE.**

I refused to quit during Hell Week and the most grueling moments of my time at BUD/S, and I refuse to quit in my race for Congress. **[Just like I swore to defend America from her enemies overseas, it is clear that just as dangerous a foe exists in the Radical Leftist policies that are destroying our country.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8e9f71b1437c43ed99487a468cc2371d&_e=1H1XZfGXVOiNy4bAMddmZ4qLnZDKkPzmk0X-vI1HffKUSAmIaExYf_7BDKdmkY0_I2EUIPGJ2KYPHu-xyOcCTiAeb6c8NXVk0kO1OsEK-KRWlbwaclleoOCiAMpwP_JMxbJbG5S2P8ydBVa0e6opC_m8dpTTUNUFtvUbhYMY7NiwhjfDo_oVhr2DN0Xyc2ztlpqJYABIta63vh30CA22KUCn7U0iR_oInJmczdeTHeuKSlVK8upIOH2PBIoxfPUUhRTBLfcGSHPTcbgrk0Drcgw-zb_1iq0nDybuueetpmCBqwH32MpSH_JpG6zlb0JAOGTOmtLMel4e2eW8cEsDydMUbQu7634ETQzBZTTRrEpujHX2Llf5mnnUN9grMpGsVgwA_Riqk-XZPkUhN2VhGAUeqLFF4io0aSuv-C-afFI%3D "Just like I swore to defend America from her enemies overseas, it is clear that just as dangerous a foe exists in the Radical Leftist policies that are destroying our country.")**

Americans are struggling to make ends meet, and Biden and Pelosi have done nothing but make this crisis even worse. I am committed to getting our economy back on track, cutting inflation, and securing our southern border.

Pelosi is pouring millions of dollars into making sure I don't win because she knows that this Navy SEAL doesn't have time for her failed leadership.

body:
Open border policies are destroying America | America is facing a crisis that challenges the idea that we are in complete control of our Nation.
_**[UPDATE ON THE SOUTHERN BORDER](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380000:JWpw0JVhN:m:1:3317145305:4F2DDFBA72CCCFDA0A7F8A3DD0BABA3A:r)**_

Dear Peter,

America is facing a crisis that challenges the idea that we are in complete control of our Nation.

For most of history, great civilizations controlled the territories they administered. If these societies could not control their borders, they ran the risk of invasions, bandits, rebellion, and anarchy. This fact remains true in the 21st Century.

_**The Democrats and radicals on the Left believe that our Country has no right to maintain border security. They think national security is an insult to a "free and compassionate society." But they are wrong, and their devotion to this idea has harmed America deeply.**_

Their open border policies have not created a more just or compassionate society. Instead, it has brought us crime, deadly narcotics, suspected terrorists, and a humanitarian crisis never before witnessed in our Country's history. Their blind rhetoric has endangered not only the lives of American citizens but also the lives of those that come here illegally.

**[Support Republicans as they fight to secure our borders.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380000:JWpw0JVhN:m:1:3317145305:4F2DDFBA72CCCFDA0A7F8A3DD0BABA3A:r)**

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380000:JWpw0JVhN:m:1:3317145305:4F2DDFBA72CCCFDA0A7F8A3DD0BABA3A:r)

America is still committed to equal opportunity and liberty for all who work for it. But if we continue disregarding our basic security, the problems caused by an open and unsecured border will destroy our communities. Republicans will continue to welcome those that come to America in pursuit of a good life, but we must be able to keep ourselves safe from those that wish to see the American experiment fail.

Our Party asks you to consider these points and stand with us as we fight for the prosperity of ALL law-abiding citizens. We ask you to reject the Democrats' misguided calls for "compassion" and instead reflect on what has made America strong: law, order, and security. Most importantly, we ask you to support Republicans as we fight to restore our majority in November.

If we fail to get our border situation under control, then we run the risk of losing our Nation. Will you join us in our fight to maintain America's existence?

**[Contribute ANY AMOUNT RIGHT NOW to help Republicans restore our majority and end harmful open border policies.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380000:JWpw0JVhN:m:1:3317145305:4F2DDFBA72CCCFDA0A7F8A3DD0BABA3A:r)**

Thank you,

The Republican Party

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380000:JWpw0JVhN:m:1:3317145305:4F2DDFBA72CCCFDA0A7F8A3DD0BABA3A:r)**

clean_body: There are hundreds of thousands of elected offices that have never been filled by a woman - this is your opportunity to change that. | | | = | | Hi Peter Willis, I am the Founder and Executive Director of Her Bold Move - and my team and I are on a mission to elect more progressive, pro-choice women to every level of our government. As hostile and draconian laws about reproductive rights appear to be supported by the Supreme Court of the United States, our work is more important today than ever before. I often think about what our nation would look like if we elected women to every seat that has yet to be filled by a woman - from city council members, to state representatives, to the President of the United States. Just imagine: Having women in the rooms where sexist and dangerous laws are being made (like the ones we're seeing right now in Georgia, Texas, and Oklahoma) to voice their concerns and lived experiences; preventing these laws from getting written in the first place. Sensible gun laws so American children no longer have reason to live in fear of our country's next school shooting. Paid parental leave (finally), so the parents of our country can take the time they need to care for newborn children and recover from childbirth. The future we could have is bold, powerful, and possible if we continue to uplift women at every level of government on our mission to shatter the glass ceilings that remain. We have a lot planned – I can't wait to tell you more. Thank you! body:
This is straight up disrespectful.
#
Derek,
At the time of this email, it’s been approximately 10 days, 14 hours, 17 minutes, and 33 seconds since the GOP national abortion ban was introduced — **and that’s exactly how long Dr. Oz has refused to tell voters how he’d vote on it.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220923-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220923-7369&refcode2=7369_434096_TSALfT&akid=7369%2E434096%2ETSALfT)
Look, I know I joke about Dr. Oz a lot. **But I want to be clear: there’s nothing funny about what’s at stake in this year’s election.**
If Oz wants to represent PA in the U.S. Senate, then he needs to tell Pennsylvanians how he would vote on this proposed abortion ban. 😡
**The dude may be a clown, but a clown with a vote is *very* scary.**
You’ll never have to guess how I would vote, Derek — **I’m pro-choice all the way.** If you send me to the Senate, I’ll block any abortion ban and vote to defend abortion access.
**[But I need your help to get there. Can you rush a donation of any amount today to our campaign so we can keep Dr. Oz out of the Senate and protect abortion access in PA + across the country??](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220923-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220923-7369&refcode2=7369_434096_TSALfT&akid=7369%2E434096%2ETSALfT)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220923-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220923-7369&refcode2=7369_434096_TSALfT&akid=7369%2E434096%2ETSALfT)**
Oz + the GOP don’t care that a majority of Americans support _Roe._ They don’t care that access to abortion saves lives. They don’t care that parenthood should always be a choice.
They don’t care that the right to choose what happens to your body + your future is a non-negotiable, fundamental, HUMAN right.
Oz has made it clear that he thinks all abortion is “murder” and he STILL won’t tell the people how he’d vote on an abortion ban. **It’s straight up disrespectful, Derek.**
**[Rush a donation of $5 or any amount today to help us win this race, flip this seat, and protect the right to an abortion. We can’t afford to let someone like Oz anywhere near the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220923-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220923-7369&refcode2=7369_434096_TSALfT&akid=7369%2E434096%2ETSALfT)**
Thank you,
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

body:
Donald Trump and Ted Budd are taking the stage together in Wilmington, North Carolina for a massive rally.
#

Friends —
**Donald Trump and Ted Budd are taking the stage together in Wilmington, North Carolina tonight for a massive rally.**
Donald Trump is personally invested in this race. Ted Budd was his first Senate endorsement this cycle, and he’s made holding North Carolina’s Senate seat a top priority.
That’s why he’s coming in for his **_third_** rally. Last time, they were joined onstage by Madison Cawthorn for a night filled with far-right foolishness. And the truth is, Trump wouldn’t be coming back here if he wasn’t worried about losing this seat.

subject: Kamala Declared War on Us!
body:
First we were firebombed. Now Kamala Harris is after us.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61379993:JDpjgJVN1:m:1:3253819041:5C75D6DEAC62CEE59CA8A95559582826:r "Headline") Peter: I just came out of an emergency meeting with our executive team to fill you in on the details. Vice President Kamala Harris has just called on Attorney Generals to go after Crisis Pregnancy Clinics like ours - And we need your help to fight back. **[Will you help us continue to save the lives of the preborn? Donate $25, $50, or $100 donation today to help us continue operating our pro-life pregnancy crisis clinics!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61379993:JDpjgJVN1:m:1:3253819041:5C75D6DEAC62CEE59CA8A95559582826:r "Will you help us continue to save the lives of the preborn? Donate
$25, $50, or $100 donation today to help us continue operating our pro-life pregnancy crisis clinics!")** Since the Supreme Court's Decision, our medical office in Buffalo was firebombed by Jane's Revenge, and there has been an influx of out-of-state mothers coming to New York to abort their babies. Our team has been working overtime to help counsel these women. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61379993:JDpjgJVN1:m:1:3253819041:5C75D6DEAC62CEE59CA8A95559582826:r "Kamala")**But now, we 're having to deal with the Biden Administration's full-frontal attack on ministries like ours.** It's bad enough we've been fighting Big Tech's removal of pro-life pregnancy centers from Google Maps, and elevating abortion giant Planned Parenthood to the first result in all unplanned pregnancy-related organic search results. It's all so bad that 28 members of Congress have had to step up and demand the FBI and federal government take seriously the hundreds of violent attacks against pro-life clinics and organizations. **Now we have pro-abortion politicians like Stacey Abrams proclaim that preborn babies don 't really have a heartbeat and it's just a "manufactured sound."** **[The attacks on our ministry are increasing and we need your donation of $50, $100, or $250 to fight back, and to continue serving women in need.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61379993:JDpjgJVN1:m:1:3253819041:5C75D6DEAC62CEE59CA8A95559582826:r "The attacks on our ministry are increasing and we need your donation of $50, $100, or $250 to fight back, and to continue serving women in
need.")** New York's Attorney General, Letitia James, the same one attacking President Trump, has already declared open season on us too. She's done nothing to hold the people accountable who attacked our medical office, but instead, she is threatening us for staying open. But as bad as it is, we don't want to put off opening a new medical office in Albany while also offering telemedicine to more than 600 pro-life medical centers nationwide. That doesn't mean you can hope that someone else will step up to help us, or that you can only focus on one important issue at a time when our nation faces many crises. We need your help. **As Ezekiel 22:30 says:** | _I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land._
---
We need gap-standers to fight and protect the preborn in this country. Time is of the essence. **[Help us serve women in need by defeating the abortionists TODAY!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61379993:JDpjgJVN1:m:1:3253819041:5C75D6DEAC62CEE59CA8A95559582826:r "Help us serve women in need by defeating the abortionists
TODAY!")**
For the preborn in Christ,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61379993:JDpjgJVN1:m:1:3253819041:5C75D6DEAC62CEE59CA8A95559582826:r "Rev. James R. Harden")

When Alexandria interviewed to join the House Oversight Committee after she was first elected in 2018, the then-chairman asked her:
“Are you willing to do the work?”
Four years later, the answer is clear. Alexandria’s question lines in committee hearings have brought results — from pressuring a Big Pharma company to lower the price of a prescription drug to forcing defense contractors to return taxpayer money. And this week — we had another win!
**Alexandria’s questioning of Trump's former fixer and attorney Michael Cohen on the Oversight Committee led to a new $250 million lawsuit this week against Trump and his adult children.**
Through Alexandria’s questioning, Michael Cohen revealed that the former president fraudulently inflated the value of his assets. This evidence was explicitly cited as the reason why New York Attorney General Letitia James brought forth this new lawsuit.1
This example, and numerous others, proves without a doubt that Alexandria is willing to do the work and that she is a better politician and strategic thinker than many give her credit for.
**Her willingness to ask the questions other people don’t consider led to this lawsuit against Trump.**

clean_body: Alexandria’s willingness to ask the questions other people don’t consider led to a new lawsuit against Trump. When Alexandria interviewed to join the House Oversight Committee after she was first elected in 2018, the then-chairman asked her: “Are you willing to do the work?” Four years later, the answer is clear. Alexandria’s question lines in committee hearings have brought results — from pressuring a Big Pharma company to lower the price of a prescription drug to forcing defense contractors to return taxpayer money. And this week — we had another win! Alexandria’s questioning of Trump's former fixer and attorney Michael Cohen on the Oversight Committee led to a new $250 million lawsuit this week against Trump and his adult children. Through Alexandria’s questioning, Michael Cohen revealed that the former president fraudulently inflated the value of his assets. This evidence was explicitly cited as the reason why New York Attorney General Letitia James brought forth this new lawsuit.1 This example, and numerous others, proves without a doubt that Alexandria is willing to do the work and that she is a better politician and strategic thinker than many give her credit for. Her willingness to ask the questions other people don’t consider led to this lawsuit against Trump. We appreciate all of you for helping build this movement and making sure we have the resources to send Alexandria back to Congress so she can continue her great work. subject: Get ready: Elissa’s 1st debate coming soon
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220923&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220923&amount=28]
Team,
Mark your calendars and get the popcorn ready... because Elissa’s first debate with her opponent airs this Sunday at 10am on Flashpoint (that's Channel 4 in Detroit).
This is the first of two televised debates Elissa challenged her opponent to in August, immediately following the primary. The second one will be on October 6th on Channel 6 (WLNS in Lansing).
They’re going to have quite a bit to discuss. As a refresher, Elissa’s opponent voted *five times* against a bipartisan deal in the state legislature that has created thousands of jobs in mid-Michigan. Majewski [in another video](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2ee7eeee-e5e0-4070-81c1-55331cef5afd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) set to go up this weekend. Majewski said he was in Afghanistan...he was loading planes with equipment in Qatar. Yes, we expect this from a guy who said all the Trump states should secede after the 2020 election, but it's important to cover their lies without the both-sides bs of our mainstream media. On my channel I lay out the Da Vince Code of who they are, waht they are trying to do, and the best ways we can stop them. And I mock them and rant a bit here and there. I think you'll enjoy it, and also think it's important that we grow our OWN media, so please subscribe to [The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/T45623c58-b8bb-4951-9be0-f7d78e3f6bcf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). Have a wonderful night and a fantastic weekend, as we recharge our batteries for next week. All my best, Cliff

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I'm writing to ask you to contribute $3 to Mandela Barnes’ campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin ahead of his upcoming FEC deadline. Please give me a chance to explain why your contribution is so important.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice.
#
Friends -
I am writing to ask you to make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. I hope you will give me a moment to explain why your contribution is so important to his campaign.
Mandela is running to defeat Republican incumbent Ron Johnson, one of the most reactionary and self-serving members of the U.S. Senate. **A recent Marquette poll shows Mandela down by one point, and he is up against some very powerful special interests who are spending obscene amounts of money to try to defeat him.**
So Mandela needs your help, especially before his FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month.
Ron Johnson is someone who relies on corporate interests to fund his campaign. But Mandela is funding his campaign the right way – from lots of people making small donations.
That is the only way he is going to have the resources to win this race, and that is why I need to ask:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin? As long as we are in this together, we are going to send Mandela to the Senate and expand the majority.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-sep22.TJJIPs&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=1&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1272?c0=mandela-em-sep22.Mxbqgo&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=20&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=mandela-em-sep22.jGAJJS&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=21&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=mandela-em-sep22.zLshxG&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=22&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=mandela-em-sep22.fMt7rX&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=23&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=mandela-em-sep22.cc5oiR&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=24&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-sep22.TJJIPs&refcode=em220923-4-sbs-acq-sp9&t=25&akid=3218%2E196590%2Ex248Tp)
At this moment in American history — in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, a global pandemic, and the existential threat of climate change — it has never been more important to elect candidates like Mandela who will fight for the working class of this country.
We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.
Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate.
First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people.
But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face.

I am nerding out right now!!!

Last week I was on PBS News Hour to talk about gate money (no burying the lead on this one). Gate money is the amount of cash that an incarcerated person receives once they leave prison. It is small and one-time only; some states don't provide it at all, nor does the federal government. [In California, that amount has been $200 for the last 50 years.](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=03dc6db035&e=e6ba7d1bc4)

Research shows that the first 72 hours after a person is released from prison is critical in determining if they will go back. Economics shows that $200 does not go far in California in 2022.

This allowance is a basic survival safety net that actually reduces recidivism. It is time that we raise the amount.

That is what I have tried to do this year with SB 1304. [PBS aired a segment on it.](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=1fafae09a8&e=e6ba7d1bc4)
---
| [ ](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=93c59cd585&e=e6ba7d1bc4)
---
Click the image to watch the segment
|
The next step is for the Governor to sign my bill. He has one week left to make it happen.

I learned about this issue from the hundreds of letters I have received from constituents and incarcerated people. I listened and took action.

It is time to change this dynamic - both in California and in Congress.

We can't address public safety, recidivism or homelessness if we are unwilling to fight poverty. What we all know to be true is that people are less likely to become homeless or commit crime if they have work, shelter and food.

So, let's get to work.... in Congress!!

clean_body: | | | | | | | | I am nerding out right now!!! Last week I was on PBS News Hour to talk about gate money (no burying the lead on this one). Gate money is the amount of cash that an incarcerated person receives once they leave prison. It is small and one-time only; some states don't provide it at all, nor does the federal government. Research shows that the first 72 hours after a person is released from prison is critical in determining if they will go back. Economics shows that $200 does not go far in California in 2022. This allowance is a basic survival safety net that actually reduces recidivism. It is time that we raise the amount. That is what I have tried to do this year with SB 1304. | Click the image to watch the segment | The next step is for the Governor to sign my bill. He has one week left to make it happen. I learned about this issue from the hundreds of letters I have received from constituents and incarcerated people. I listened and took action. It is time to change this dynamic - both in California and in Congress. We can't address public safety, recidivism or homelessness if we are unwilling to fight poverty. What we all know to be true is that people are less likely to become homeless or commit crime if they have work, shelter and food. So, let's get to work.... in Congress!! | | "CONTRIBUTE" | Onward! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Paid for by Sydney Kamlager for Congress 419 N. | | Early voting started TODAY! Time is running out to reach voters and we need your help. Join us for one or more of these volunteer opportunities.

_**PHONE BANKING**_

We've got a phone banking opportunity TOMORROW. _Will you join us?_

Make sure to bring your own device. You can bring a laptop, iPad, tablet or smart phone. Also, headphones will really help. To schedule a shift, fill out the form below with all the times you are available.

_**WHERE:**_

Filament Workplace (enter the Re/Max doors and go to the 2nd floor)
14451 Hwy 7
Minnetonka, MN 55345

_**WHEN:**_

__**Saturday, September 24, noon-3:00 PM**__
Tuesday, September 27, 5:00-8:00 PM
Saturday, October 1, noon-3:00 PM
**[RSVP HERE](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=405c7ce2c1&e=33b11688c1)**
_**CALLING FROM HOME**_

We have an incredible system that allows for people to make calls from home. I know that not everyone lives close enough to our phone banking location or are available during the scheduled shifts. BUT YOU CAN STILL MAKE CALLS! Fill out the form below and someone from our team will reach out to get you set up to make calls. _It's that simple!_

We can’t let this dude anywhere near the U.S. Senate.👇 There is simply too much on the line to let Hollywood’s Doctor Oz become Senator Oz. We hate to say it, Derek, but it gets even worse. Dr. Oz winning this seat is the GOP’s #1 chance to flip the entire freakin’ Senate. So we’re not just talking about the nightmare of Senator Oz... we’re talking about Senator Oz as part of an extreme GOP Senate majority led by Mitch McConnell. subject: Tough times
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
In combat, I had my wingmen and in these campaigns, I have you.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/27126?t=6&akid=4647%2E878179%2EqAH6gc) _Gabby and me during her recovery_ Friends --

When I think about the toughest times in my life, I'm thankful I've always had a support system to help me through.

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn't always easy.

Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn't easy.

Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn't easy.

Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally -- that hasn't been easy either.

But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.

In combat, I had my wingmen.

With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.

And in these campaigns, I have you.

I could not do this without you. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you'd make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we're going to defeat our Republican opponent and hold this seat. [**Please, can you split a $10 contribution between my re-election campaign and Voter Protection Project before our next fundraising deadline? Peter Willis,

Election Day is just six weeks out, and what
we do now will determine our fate.

people; if we lose, we’ll have right wing radicals Dr. Oz and Ron Johnson

name: Max Steiner
subject: Here's what's going on in the world this week:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
I'm always a little depressed at how insular most Americans are...... | |
---
Happy Friday, friend.

We are 46 days from November 8th. Now is the time to be hassling your friends to register to vote - and hopefully to vote for me (and other Democrats on the ballot). Today I wanted to "zoom out" a bit on the email though. I talk a lot about American democracy and about domestic policies I want to enact, but there's a whole world outside our borders that we should be cognizant of as well. Maybe it's just the soldier and diplomat in me, but I'm always a little depressed at how insular most Americans are. I'm not asking everyone to be a foreign policy expert, but politicians should at least be aware of the rest of the world and its problems. I have seen little from Doug LaMalfa that implies any such international curiosity -- outside of Fox News headlines (besides where he can sell his rice). So what is going on in the world this week? 1.) **Russia has decided to mobilize, which indicates a massive escalation of the Ukraine war.** It's also caused some domestic dissent - because no one wants to be drafted for Putin's imperialist invasion.

The U.S. should continue to support Ukraine while ensuring that the conflict remains a local one. 2.) **There are massive protests in Iran after a young woman was killed by "morality police" for not wearing a headscarf.** The protests have no expanded beyond feminism to broader dissatisfaction with the regime. The U.S. should support these protestors by applying pressure on Iran to prevent a harsh crackdown like the last round in 2009. The Islamic Republic does not represent the will of the Iranian people. clean_body: I'm always a little depressed at how insular most Americans are...... | | Happy Friday, friend. We are 46 days from November 8th. Now is the time to be hassling your friends to register to vote - and hopefully to vote for me (and other Democrats on the ballot). Today I wanted to "zoom out" a bit on the email though. I talk a lot about American democracy and about domestic policies I want to enact, but there's a whole world outside our borders that we should be cognizant of as well. Maybe it's just the soldier and diplomat in me, but I'm always a little depressed at how insular most Americans are. I'm not asking everyone to be a foreign policy expert, but politicians should at least be aware of the rest of the world and its problems. I have seen little from Doug LaMalfa that implies any such international curiosity -- outside of Fox News headlines (besides where he can sell his rice). So what is going on in the world this week? 1.) Russia has decided to mobilize, which indicates a massive escalation of the Ukraine war. It's also caused some domestic dissent - because no one wants to be drafted for Putin's imperialist invasion. The U.S. should continue to support Ukraine while ensuring that the conflict remains a local one. 2.) There are massive protests in Iran after a young woman was killed by "morality police" for not wearing a headscarf. | | ANTRIM COUNTY, Mich. — Law enforcement is investigating a death threat sent to US Congressional candidate Dr. Bob Lorinser. The campaign immediately reported the explicit assassination threat to local authorities, which successfully contacted the alleged perpetrator and began an investigation. Because of the specificity of the message, Lorinser also reported the threat to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). On Thurs. Sept. 22, the campaign received the following text message in reply to an event invitation in Elk Rapids: “I am going to assassinate Dr. Bob Lorinser during this event using a Remington .270 rifle from the rooftop of a nearby building, the moment he exits his vehicle.” Details about the sender are not available. "I want to thank law enforcement for responding," said Lorinser. "Authorities should always take these matters seriously to ensure the public's safety. I’m confident the police will handle the situation properly. Fortunately, this threat is not indicative of the warm reception we receive across the state. It isn’t who we are as Northern Michiganders. The campaign will fearlessly move forward.” # # # Dr. Bob Lorinser is running for US Congress in Michigan’s 1st Congressional District, covering Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula. The midterm election is on Tues. Nov. 8, 2022.

---
| | [](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3b8c83061ae742fab39dec385beebda6&_e=9p2Pk7wRR78wEb9bjsv3D6qW6yRsxcv6iKaW9vSJS1hKVWUsEK27gQdWyPprM_-zt9TmdpIczfALCFVhtSZSlZ32txe93WWL80ynIqxhemV0peRXVPXJAj_A-6R9TkPM1DbuLPYbeuxhiUcGj0CgIDOzqmwKfb0C1nOXrX8HwzC9giy4QypJ2gNtnJrNWXhzBiy3ftc560nJ948EloRiZ1oF_7TvfEsmQyh4QuJeYMRUz26Gw5zfd5UB_xXhQyjS)

This week, Greg Norman, the chairman and CEO of LIV Golf, [met](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3b8c83061ae742fab39dec385beebda6&_e=9p2Pk7wRR78wEb9bjsv3Dz-nnp6nxUXdSnKqwpiTZ_j1Rx6doF1QttY-cjP1bwUFObAhUlolhsQ4CnfU_c5bxIWUTElvaGqpJpJ090xb1enFHxq8YrXHgsf2oD27dlIBLdnoPm5ZpiGercMayRKwhHlRcJN7PZaGMIjaqGhwwF1pJyZO54sH6-erzFxZLZG0UNgw6tcpavE7VrbKsIwq3W3A0XyyuG5agIXirt_EqHoV40g1HJngUj8sqxPPfjg1C2xXqz45ZJ343yGhXHoU6LOf3VEtypsXp00I5656hNw%3D) with the Republican Study Committee to try his darndest to push his new golf league backed by the Saudi government. Let me catch you up in case you don't follow golf: LIV Golf started this year as a PGA Tour competitor. While I'm a huge proponent of competition, I am not a proponent of dark money that weakens America's economy. And that's exactly what [LIV Golf's business model](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3b8c83061ae742fab39dec385beebda6&_e=9p2Pk7wRR78wEb9bjsv3DxhTs1L7NLIw4O6IaZZ0_tcmTRyMbbgnfDeezodBQeKy937F_8gwtmiqzX56yJdrVQpazvfVvv0Qk_wxvHYGPkc7exSz-spC6gyWp126UyBRf-mSpP7MVwy1w5XaUOkGsjDjcyunsE7lOs-DGrPdDyoHT-GQdSqKWdvDJxn-UKvs1yZ-wfnCcd_nveFwIbnOzJld_asnRXMZd4RcqYmpP4szHV0P8MXRuBNeWQ-FYoMMfUktsItnlDksInQUDDkKwtHLcWr3lGuN2xadDloGB9cwoL290ymFk8wQwlUZxICX) strives off of since it’s backed by a bunch of [Saudis and foreign billionaire oil people](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3b8c83061ae742fab39dec385beebda6&_e=9p2Pk7wRR78wEb9bjsv3D_aaDiDDCe-zo4kfNwFlEO7RTT4kORYk1aUaLe4FbUOvoP7e46MyM8M4Bg5PDRFvPNM67FJVf_ZEC7HYd0VOKnhWgq34gr5d1CPirvtZnarZRNRLxZHytxvZHCvzuwykQVXoMzoZG-PZvvYUKFXULAy9c05pwT4eDbGVdEhyGb6BF9n79bEi045PJCPRPgRSQFYttNbhOmGpzCZ5e6DRXsX3gFf1byiVw9qMKxC7iTz0vITkJPq4lqdkhP7bwMfQzDEQryR6Gu_RwzpRkmGeYIA5YD1qU0tRwO7_c0CfX-5c) who couldn't give two hoots about America. That's where Norman lost me in his propaganda.
In all seriousness, government shouldn't be [wasting its time](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3b8c83061ae742fab39dec385beebda6&_e=9p2Pk7wRR78wEb9bjsv3D3BYJPIXuGzecYrQkXbrf9eb5xbsO8Ju-Kqjzr1F7HTC8D4MY3-u760aL6NTn0KFipFBohA3cy1rrBaF5Ph-cLfdsOcMNnKCpgWzxo9zy5XHGOK_RICpGps8cAYTqUXh6yvilDNtPT13WO4WSwnXWT9fTzvFuqhj8NeYbhR382Opl85vpWEIwo5S0VGbpL--XxDSdWa-nslth2kbhS8B6owtt3cafz5782j8Zb-M5CFbym5c9v2aBBU_cX9_CTEc_CZTqiQMpFz50CQPT9_9BYaykTW3cZwQIuI8Uz2gFPqj) on the question of where a bunch of rich dudes play golf. Remember when the federal government made the big mistake of getting involved in Major League Baseball? It's time we get our priorities straight and focus on the _real_ issues that impact hardworking Americans.

| Team,

A Pima County judge just reinstated a pre-statehood abortion ban here in Arizona, with required jail time for doctors and pharmacists. **_It will have catastrophic impacts on Arizonans._**

This is the exact extreme overreach we knew the AZ GOP would want after the Supreme Court overturned itself and the right to abortion access. But it is not what Arizonans want.

This ban puts Arizonans at risk, as doctors and pharmacists will be paralyzed by fear of jail time for providing care. And **it puts our current Republican elected officials in charge of Arizonans reproductive health care.**

This ruling may be overturned on appeal, but the message is clear – _the AZ GOP will never stop infringing on our freedoms._ They won’t stop until they have total bans, with jailed medical providers as trophies, and then they’ll come for other reproductive health services.

**__The only way to stop this is to vote them out.__**

We need an Attorney General who will use the Arizona Constitution’s privacy clause to protect Arizonans, a Governor who will block these extreme overreaches, and a Democratic-led legislature to repeal this total ban completely.

clean_body: | | | We can stop this at the ballot box | | | Team, A Pima County judge just reinstated a pre-statehood abortion ban here in Arizona, with required jail time for doctors and pharmacists. It will have catastrophic impacts on Arizonans. This is the exact extreme overreach we knew the AZ GOP would want after the Supreme Court overturned itself and the right to abortion access. But it is not what Arizonans want. This ban puts Arizonans at risk, as doctors and pharmacists will be paralyzed by fear of jail time for providing care. And it puts our current Republican elected officials in charge of Arizonans reproductive health care. This ruling may be overturned on appeal, but the message is clear – the AZ GOP will never stop infringing on our freedoms. They won’t stop until they have total bans, with jailed medical providers as trophies, and then they’ll come for other reproductive health services. The only way to stop this is to vote them out. We need an Attorney General who will use the Arizona Constitution’s privacy clause to protect Arizonans, a Governor who will block these extreme overreaches, and a Democratic-led legislature to repeal this total ban completely.
